trust_decision.summary: build_trigger decides that the reserved job-arg keys (primary_key, metadata, action_arguments, tenant, actor) come only from the record/trusted options, not from caller :args or trigger extra_args; at the pinned commit the merge only lets atom-keyed base entries win, so string-keyed caller entries survive alongside them.

landing_point.why: The summary names :args; the only place :args is merged into job args is this Map.merge in build_trigger, documented at lib/ash_oban.ex:982-984.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API AshOban.build_trigger/3, AshOban.run_trigger/3, AshOban.run_triggers/3 (lib/ash_oban.ex:944-969), the AshOban.Changes.RunObanTrigger change via oban_job_opts (lib/changes/run_oban_trigger.ex:21-30, 64-72), and trigger DSL extra_args (lib/ash_oban.ex:214-218) reached from the generated scheduler (lib/transformers/define_schedulers.ex:267)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Weak: all four entry points funnel into the single build_trigger merge; a solver could only argue that extra_args is developer-controlled DSL config, not caller input, and leave line 1071 alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-reserved caller :args (uniqueness keys) and extra_args keys used for chunk partitioning (`by [:shard_id]`) must still reach the job args; base atom keys must keep their atom-keyed values.

O6_input_shapes: atom-keyed reserved keys in :args (fix normalises with to_string)
reserved keys from trigger extra_args as a static map
reserved keys from trigger extra_args as a function of the record

O7_producer.where: lib/ash_oban.ex:1073 (trigger.worker.new hands the mixed atom/string-keyed map to Oban, whose JSON encoding collapses :primary_key and "primary_key" into one key read back at lib/transformers/define_schedulers.ex:1132,1147)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: AshOban.schedule/3 gaining an :args option merged into the scheduler / scheduled-action job args the same way
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: build_trigger already offers :args for uniqueness; a maintainer adding parity to schedule/3 would copy the same Map.merge, and the scheduled-action worker reads "tenant" and "actor" straight from args (lib/transformers/define_action_workers.ex:92-105).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: worker-side build_input merging caller-controlled action_arguments with reserved "primary_key"/"metadata" in an order that lets the caller win
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The atomic path already merges in a different order from the non-atomic one (lib/transformers/define_schedulers.ex:1155,1174 vs 1104-1106), so a reorder is a plausible maintainer edit.

O9_family: mass assignment / reserved-key override via map merge (CWE-915), atom-vs-string key identity differential across JSON serialisation

O10_build.toolchain: mix (Elixir/OTP), hex deps ash, oban, ecto
O10_build.project_tests: test/ash_oban_test.exs (build_trigger tests near line 50); test/chunks_test.exs needs Oban Pro license (config/config.exs:19-20)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Swap merge order or drop only atom keys, leaving string-keyed "primary_key" etc. to collide after JSON encoding; or strip only from :args and not from extra_args.

out_of_scope_notes: Atomic trigger path lets job action_arguments override trigger action_input (lib/transformers/define_schedulers.ex:1174), whereas the non-atomic path lets action_input win (lib/transformers/define_schedulers.ex:1105); a different property, not pursued.
